# LYRA automatic picker -- what CryoStack runs it with.
#
# LYRA's handoff (Pickers/Automatic_picker/LYRA.zip, guide of 13 October 2026)
# refers to a requirements.txt that the archive does not contain, so these are
# NOT LYRA's own pins. They are the direct dependencies of the scripts the
# runner executes (detect_frames.py, calibrate.py, echoes.py and the modules
# they import), with the versions CryoStack validated them at.
#
# By default LYRA runs in the gateway's Python (tools/icesee1_environment.yml);
# set CRYOSTACK_FROZEN_LEGACIES_LYRA_PYTHON to use a separate environment.
#
# Validated on Linux (RHEL 9, x86_64), 2026-10-14, phase 1 (frame detection
# and CBD OCR) on F127 reel 47_0004650_0004674: the frame index is byte-identical
# under both sets below. Phases 3-4 (calibration, echoes) have not run on real
# data: no human calibration picks exist yet.
#
#   gateway environment:   python 3.11.15  numpy 2.4.6   pandas 3.0.3
#                          matplotlib 3.11.0  pillow 12.3.0
#   URSA environment:      python 3.11.17  numpy 1.26.4  pandas 2.2.3
#                          matplotlib 3.9.2   pillow 12.3.0
#
# Not needed by CryoStack's runner:
#   PyQt6 -- only pick_calibration.py (LYRA's interactive desktop picker) and
#            echoes.py --review, which CryoStack never runs.
#   scipy -- only LYRA's navigation and validation helpers (lyra.py nav
#            routines, validate_flight.py), which need reference files that are
#            not part of the handoff.
numpy>=1.26
pandas>=2.2
matplotlib>=3.9
Pillow>=10
